Hi team,

Drafting the invite and the operational plan for the Dec 8 webinar (90 minutes, deep dive + live Q&A). Attaching first-pass copy and the Q4 segmentation export. High level asks:

Attachments: [Attachment: invite-copy-v1.docx (docx, 24 KB)], [Attachment: segment-list-q4.csv (csv, 46 KB)], [Attachment: tracking-map.xlsx (xlsx, 18 KB)].

Suggested send cadence (US):
1) Initial invite (Dec 1)
2) Reminder 1 (Dec 4)
3) Last-chance (Dec 7 morning)
4) On-day reminder for registrants (Dec 8 1 hour before)

Copy notes: call out practical outcomes (latency/cost analysis, case study of 3 architectures), include explicit CTA variants: "Reserve your seat" and "See cost breakdown" for A/B. Also plan an RSVP landing page with prefilled HubSpot values.

Action items: please reply with:
- Marissa: edits to the copy and recommended CTA to A/B test
- Grace: segment tweaks + timezone splits for APAC/EU (we'll stagger sends)
- Laura: confirm tracking & legal check timeline

Thanks — sending to partners after we lock copy.
